about: Pack Council 2026-10-16 (round 1): every plain-words discover query the brothers really ran, each with the tool(s) that must land in the top 5. Gathered by Juniper. Run scripts/discover_eval.py against the live house before and after any change to services/tool_discovery.py or a tool description. Add a row whenever a brother misses a door.
